title: Reference-driven rabbit geometry only: carved features, editable model and orthographic review
acceptance_criteria: Editable self-contained metric T-pose rabbit model, with geometry matching the supplied front/right/back reference rather than a generic rabbit.
Actual modeled ear channels, orbital sockets, muzzle, U-shaped open jaw, rounded dental arches, fingers, toes, bow and damaged shell sections.
Geometry audit and both saved-scene reopen validations pass, all mandatory images decode, and actual high-resolution views are reviewed by ChatGPT against the reference.
No texture generation or projected image camouflage; neutral inspection materials only. Record remaining geometric deviations explicitly.
Release archive and manifest hashes and workspace-state must be read back before reporting durable save.
